svg.title: T15.2_protocol_vector_corner_case_suite
svg.text: T15.2 Protocol Vector and Corner-Case Suite
Directed vectors turn Rel-19 clauses and decoder edge cases into replayable pass/fail evidence.

text.tspan: TS section, table, formula, local path, extraction note
schema version, vector id, family, seed, expected status,
soft combine, CB/TB CRC and timeout.
BG/Zc, filler, puncture, limited buffer, RV/k0,
small block, CRC length, frozen mask, rate recovery,
positive vectors require exact payload and
checkpoints; negative vectors require expected fail
descriptor, address trace, LLR snapshot, first
mismatch, replay command and protocol evidence.

Cross-family directed vectors: no-noise smoke, min/max sizes, LLR sign and saturation, CRC fail, expected-fail classification, mid-run reset, timeout and replay. Protocol-derived fields live in vector.json; implementation policies live in suite_policy.json and checkpoint_manifest.

B,C,r,K,F,E,Ncb,Kw,rv,k0, masks, soft before/after, CB/TB CRC

wrong H shape, wrong circular-buffer address, held CBG corruption, syndrome/CRC

wrong branch, wrong selector, path pruned, unstable tie-break, mask index error
context,A,K,E,N,crc_len,RNTI,info/frozen hash, L, PM list, selector result

no silent pass; replay reproduces first mismatch

Read order: evidence -> manifest -> family lane -> expected outcome -> failure bundle -> regression tier. Engineering check: every vector must say whether it is protocol-derived, implementation-policy-derived, or negative expected-fail. Visual check: tables use 24px text and 122px+ row height; arrows use
